subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this protected prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is model-facing prompt policy plus nested-spawn semantics across current runtime, docs, and tests, which automation should not choose for a maintainer-labeled PR.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into current availability- and depth-aware prompt and tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, update runtime depth behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Pause As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is enough, leave or close this protected branch by explicit maintainer decision without carrying the stale rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into current availability- and depth-aware prompt and tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main blame and GitHub metadata are the strongest routing signal for the overlapping prompt and sub-agent guidance surfaces.
